equivalentMutants.reason: The supports filter treats both undefined from an empty catch block and explicit false as falsy, so a throwing provider is excluded in either case.
Rejected PromiseSettledResult objects have no value; the remaining runtime result validator rejects undefined, so both forms skip exactly the same rejected providers.
For absent checkedAt, both the empty string and Stryker placeholder parse to NaN and select the same injected or system clock.
JSON.stringify omits object properties whose values are undefined, so unconditional insertion of absent after_index produces identical serialized bytes.

Inputs arrive from JSON.parse. Null and arrays remain separately rejected; string, number and boolean primitives cannot carry the required version and fields, so the remaining checks reject them.
The anchored base64url pattern requires at least one character. Removing the separate zero-length check still rejects every empty cursor with the same error.
